# Soros Febriano Personal Website - LLM Context

## Project Overview
This is a personal portfolio website built with Next.js 14, featuring an Xbox 360-inspired design with skeumorphic elements, 3D effects, and interactive components. The site showcases projects, blog posts, photos, and includes integrations with Spotify and Medium.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: CSS Modules with PostCSS
- **Animations**: Framer Motion
- **State Management**: React Context
- **Image Handling**: Cloudinary via next-cloudinary
- **Documentation**: Storybook
- **Testing**: Jest (planned)
- **Deployment**: Vercel

## Key Dependencies
- react, react-dom, next
- framer-motion (animations)
- next-cloudinary (image optimization)
- shepherd.js (user tours)
- @storybook/nextjs (component documentation)
- typescript, @types packages

## Architecture Patterns
- **Composition over Inheritance**: Components use composition patterns
- **Context Pattern**: VolumeContext, ShepherdTourContext for global state
- **Strategy Pattern**: Different rendering strategies in PageLayout
- **Module Pattern**: CSS Modules for scoped styling
- **Custom Hook Pattern**: useVolume for audio management

## Folder Structure
```
src/
├── app/                 # Next.js App Router pages
├── components/          # Reusable React components
├── context/            # React Context providers
├── data/               # Static JSON data files
├── stories/            # Storybook stories
└── types/              # TypeScript type definitions

public/
├── assets/             # Static assets (audio, images, icons)
├── robots.txt          # SEO configuration
└── sitemap.xml         # Generated sitemap
```

## Design System
- **Theme**: Xbox 360-inspired skeumorphism
- **Colors**: Green gradients (rgb(108 184 43), rgb(78 156 27))
- **Typography**: Segoe UI, Arial fallbacks
- **Sound**: PS2/Xbox audio feedback on interactions
- **Layout**: Responsive grid with CSS custom properties

## Component Guidelines
- Use TypeScript interfaces for all props
- Include comprehensive JSDoc comments
- Implement audio feedback via useVolume hook
- Use CSS Modules for styling with BEM-like naming
- Include Storybook stories for complex components
- Follow accessibility best practices

## Audio System
- Volume controlled via VolumeContext
- Consistent sound files in /assets/audio/
- Sound effects: hover, click, navigation, ambient
- Graceful fallback for autoplay restrictions

## Data Sources
- **Blog**: Medium RSS feed via /api/medium-feed
- **Music**: Spotify API via /api/playlists
- **Images**: Cloudinary with local JSON manifests
- **Projects**: Static JSON data

## Styling Conventions
- CSS Modules with `.module.css` suffix
- CSS custom properties for theming
- Responsive design with mobile-first approach
- Skeumorphic effects: gradients, shadows, reflections
- Smooth transitions and hover states

## Performance Optimizations
- Next.js Image component for optimized loading
- Cloudinary for image transformation
- CSS-in-JS avoided in favor of CSS Modules
- Lazy loading for heavy components
- Static generation where possible

## SEO Configuration
- robots.txt with proper directives
- Dynamic sitemap generation
- Meta tags via Next.js metadata API
- Structured data for rich snippets

## Development Workflow
- TypeScript strict mode enabled
- ESLint and Prettier for code quality
- Storybook for component development
- Git hooks for pre-commit validation
- Vercel for continuous deployment

## Browser Support
- Modern browsers (ES2020+)
- Mobile-responsive design
- Progressive enhancement approach
- Graceful degradation for audio features

## Known Issues & Constraints
- Audio autoplay limited by browser policies
- Cloudinary free tier limitations
- Medium RSS parsing complexity
- Spotify API rate limiting

## Future Enhancements
- Dark/light theme toggle
- WebGL effects for enhanced visuals
- PWA capabilities
- Advanced animations with Lottie
- CMS integration for content management

## Code Style Preferences
- Functional components with hooks
- Explicit return types for functions
- Comprehensive error handling
- Descriptive variable and function names
- Single responsibility principle
- Composition over inheritance
- Immutable state updates

## Testing Strategy
- Component testing with Jest/React Testing Library
- Storybook for visual regression testing
- Manual testing across devices
- Performance monitoring with Lighthouse
- Accessibility testing with axe-core

## Documentation Standards
- JSDoc comments for all public APIs
- README files for complex components
- Storybook stories with examples
- Type definitions with descriptions
- Inline comments for complex logic

This file helps AI assistants understand the codebase structure, patterns, and preferences when suggesting changes or new features.
